scope: Selected peer-reviewed papers relevant to MJB mechanism research; not an exhaustive systematic search
storage_policy: Link-to-original by default; licensed full text may be archived after per-paper rights check

records.title: Proteolytic control of the mitochondrial calcium uniporter complex
records.demonstrates: AFG3L2/SPG7 m-AAA proteases degrade surplus unassembled EMRE; protease-resistant EMRE permits poorly gated calcium entry in experimental systems.
records.does_not_demonstrate: A direction or magnitude of mitochondrial calcium abnormality in a particular patient or SPG7 genotype.

records.title: SPG7 targets the m-AAA protease complex to process MCU for uniporter assembly, Ca2+ influx, and regulation of mitochondrial permeability transition pore opening
records.demonstrates: Loss of SPG7 reduced mitochondrial calcium and altered MCU-complex formation in the studied model; apparent resistance to calcium-induced pore opening tracked lower matrix calcium.
records.does_not_demonstrate: SPG7 loss always increases matrix calcium or that SPG7 is the pore's structural core.

records.title: Rescue of mitochondrial and neurite pathology in SPG7 hereditary spastic paraplegia patient-derived cortical neurons
records.model: cortical neurons derived from 3 SPG7 patients and 3 matched controls
records.demonstrates: Abnormal mitochondrial ultrastructure and slower anterograde axonal mitochondrial transport in patient-derived neurons; Bz-423 improved selected in-vitro phenotypes.
records.does_not_demonstrate: Calcium concentrations directly measured in these neurons, safe clinical efficacy of Bz-423, or an established treatment for HSP.

records.title: Structure and mechanism of the mitochondrial calcium transporter NCLX
records.demonstrates: Structural/functional results support an H+/Ca2+ exchange role for NCLX, challenging its conventional Na+/Ca2+ assignment.
records.does_not_demonstrate: The complete cellular contribution of NCLX in all tissues or the exclusion of other calcium efflux pathways.

records.title: TMEM65 functions as the mitochondrial Na+/Ca2+ exchanger
records.design: primary biochemical, structural and cellular function experiments
records.model: cultured cells and mitochondrial exchanger assays
records.demonstrates: TMEM65 depletion impaired mitochondrial Na+/Ca2+ exchange; expressing TMEM65 conferred exchange in the experimental cellular setting.
records.does_not_demonstrate: All mitochondrial calcium exit in all tissues is exclusively TMEM65-dependent.

records.title: TMEM65 regulates and is required for NCLX-dependent mitochondrial calcium efflux
records.design: primary proximity proteomics and loss-of-function biology
records.demonstrates: TMEM65 interacts with NCLX and modulates Na+-dependent mitochondrial calcium extrusion in studied models; loss affects organ physiology.
records.does_not_demonstrate: That NCLX alone is the ion-exchange transporter or resolve transporter identity controversy.

records.title: Mitochondrial calcium transport in amino acid metabolism: from nutritional responses to metabolic regulation
records.model: synthesis of prior molecular and metabolic research
records.demonstrates: Synthesises MCU complex, m-AAA/EMRE and competing assignments of NCLX/TMEM65; explicitly states that exact mitochondrial calcium efflux roles remain contentious.
records.does_not_demonstrate: Original direct measurement of any individual's metabolism or a resolution of the exchanger dispute.

records.title: Drug inhibition and substrate transport mechanisms of human VMAT2
records.design: primary human protein cryo-EM, cell assays and simulation
records.model: human VMAT2 structures and heterologous cell transport measurements
records.demonstrates: Structures of human VMAT2 bound to dopamine/serotonin and inhibitors reveal substrate-binding states, conformational mechanisms and importance of a vesicular proton gradient.
records.does_not_demonstrate: A patient's VMAT2 deficit or direct amphetamine versus methylphenidate clinical superiority.

records.title: Amphetamine-induced reverse transport of dopamine does not require cytosolic Ca2+
records.model: cultured dopaminergic neurons plus extracellular dopamine sensing cells
records.demonstrates: In cultured dopamine neurons amphetamine-evoked DAT-mediated efflux persisted despite calcium-channel blockade/chelation and action-potential suppression, while requiring DAT and VMAT2 function.
records.does_not_demonstrate: That neuronal calcium handling is abnormal in responders to dexamfetamine or that the effect translates into an individual's motor symptoms.

records.title: Pharmacological and non-pharmacological modulation of striatal dopamine release: a meta-analysis of [11C]raclopride PET studies
records.model: 92 PET studies / total n=1640, heterogeneous protocols
records.demonstrates: Both amphetamine and methylphenidate substantially increased striatal extracellular dopamine proxies in pooled human PET studies; approximate average changes were 10.9% vs 11.5% by [11C]raclopride binding measures.
records.does_not_demonstrate: Equality of clinical response, isolated tonic/phasic mechanisms, identical dosage routes or an individual's neurotransmitter lesion.

records.title: Clinical, morphological and genetic characterization of Brody disease: an international study of 40 patients
records.demonstrates: Exercise-induced stiffness, delayed relaxation, frequently preserved strength; electrically silent contractures in about half; reduced SERCA1 activity/protein.
records.does_not_demonstrate: All exercise stiffness is Brody disease, a universal SPG7-to-SERCA causal link, or that normal nerve conduction alone proves silent contracture.

records.title: Toe walking in children and adolescents with Autism Spectrum Disorder: Relationship with sensory and motor functions, language, cognition, and autism severity
records.model: 112 autistic participants; 61 with and 51 without toe walking
records.demonstrates: Toe-walking group had greater motor and developmental difficulties; Short Sensory Profile scores did not differ significantly between groups.
records.does_not_demonstrate: Absence of sensory differences in every individual, causation by calcium pumps, or inevitable progression with age.

records.title: Comparative effectiveness of conservative and surgical interventions for toe walking in children with Autism Spectrum Disorder: a systematic review
records.design: systematic review without pooled comparable effect estimate
records.model: 8 studies, 424 autistic participants, heterogeneous study designs/outcomes
records.demonstrates: Available intervention studies are highly heterogeneous and very-low-certainty; no reliable superiority ranking of treatment approaches can be made.
records.does_not_demonstrate: That multimodal therapy definitively outperforms surgery or any other intervention.

records.title: Investigating the Relationship Between Sensory Processing, Pain and Toe Walking Gait: A Survey Study
records.model: 176 parents reporting on 187 children who toe-walk
records.demonstrates: Parents frequently reported sensory processing issues (98% within autistic toe-walking subgroup) and pain (48% of all toe-walking children) in this selected sample.
records.does_not_demonstrate: Sensory differences caused toe-walking; without a non-toe-walking comparison the high sensory prevalence cannot determine what distinguishes toe-walkers.
